en.title: A Behavior Change Needs Tests
en.description: Start with TDD when the expected behavior can be stated and checked before implementation.

zh.title: 行为变更需要测试
zh.description: 当预期行为能先被明确描述并验证时，优先查看 TDD。

en.title: A Failure Has No Clear Cause
en.description: Use diagnosis or investigation guidance to rank evidence before editing the suspected code.

zh.title: 故障原因尚不明确
zh.description: 先用诊断或调查指引整理证据，不要立即修改猜测中的代码。

en.title: A Codebase Needs Improvement
en.description: Choose React-specific guidance for performance issues, or Safe Refactor when behavior must remain unchanged.

zh.title: 代码需要改进
zh.description: 性能问题选择对应的 React 指引；需要保持既有行为时选择 Safe Refactor。

en.question: How should I choose between debugging, TDD, and refactoring guidance?
en.answer: Start with the current uncertainty. Debugging investigates why behavior is wrong; TDD makes an expected behavior executable; refactoring improves structure while preserving behavior. A single task may move through all three, but they answer different questions.

en.question: What makes a useful bug report for a coding agent?
en.answer: Provide the smallest reproducible example, expected and actual behavior, relevant errors, and the environment where the issue occurs. A failing test or concrete input is more actionable than a general statement that the code is broken.

en.question: Should every change begin with a new test?
en.answer: A test is valuable when it can detect the behavior or regression at issue. Exploratory work may first need a clearer requirement; cosmetic changes may need visual checks. Avoid tests that merely repeat the implementation without checking a meaningful outcome.

en.question: How can I verify that a refactor preserved behavior?
en.answer: Record the behavior that must remain stable, run relevant checks, and review the diff for accidental scope changes. Passing tests are useful evidence, but untested interfaces and error paths may still need targeted inspection.

en.question: When should I use React-specific performance guidance?
en.answer: Use it when the problem involves React or Next.js concerns such as rendering, data fetching, state, or bundle size. Measure the actual application so a plausible optimization does not become an unverified change with no demonstrated benefit.

en.question: Can several coding Skills be combined in one task?
en.answer: Yes, when their roles are clear. For example, reproduce a failure, isolate the cause, make a small change, and then inspect the diff. Resolve conflicting instructions and keep one acceptance criterion rather than layering unrelated checklists.

zh.question: 调试、TDD 和重构指引应该怎样选？
zh.answer: 先判断当前不确定什么。调试追查错误原因，TDD 将预期行为变成可执行验证，重构在保持行为的前提下改善结构。同一任务可能依次用到三者，但它们回答的问题不同。

zh.question: 给编程 Agent 的故障描述怎样才有用？
zh.answer: 提供最小复现、预期与实际行为、相关错误和运行环境。一个失败测试或具体输入，比笼统地说“代码有问题”更有助于定位。

zh.question: 每次修改都必须先写新测试吗？
zh.answer: 测试应能发现所关注的行为或回归。探索任务可能先要澄清需求，外观修改可能更需要视觉检查；不要为了数量编写只重复实现的测试。

zh.question: 怎样核对重构没有改变行为？
zh.answer: 先记录必须保持的行为，再运行相关检查，并审阅差异是否意外扩大范围。测试通过是证据，但未覆盖的接口和错误路径仍可能需要专项检查。

zh.question: 什么时候应该用 React 专项性能指引？
zh.answer: 问题涉及 React 或 Next.js 的渲染、数据请求、状态或包体积时更适合。仍需测量真实应用，避免把看似合理的优化当作已经产生收益。

zh.question: 一个任务可以组合多个编码 Skill 吗？
zh.answer: 可以，但应明确分工，例如先复现、再定位、实施小改动、最后审阅差异。遇到冲突指令应先解决，并围绕同一验收目标执行，不叠加无关清单。

zh.title: 组件越来越难改

en.title: The App Needs a Real Check
en.description: Webapp Testing focuses on running and inspecting the application, not only reviewing source code.

zh.title: 应用需要真实验证
zh.description: Webapp Testing 聚焦运行和检查应用，而不仅仅是阅读源码。

en.question: How is this category different from hands-on Coding Skills?
en.answer: Development covers decisions around the code change: understanding a system, clarifying a plan, designing components, and checking a running application. Coding focuses more narrowly on implementing, testing, or debugging the change itself.

en.question: What should I resolve before asking an agent to implement a plan?
en.answer: Define the user outcome, constraints, affected interfaces, and how success will be checked. If a consequential decision is still open, surface it explicitly so the implementation does not silently turn an assumption into a requirement.

en.question: When is reverse engineering the right approach?
en.answer: Use it when understanding a shipped application or binary is necessary and authorized, especially when source code is unavailable. Keep the investigation focused on a specific question and separate observed evidence from hypotheses about internal design.

en.question: How do component composition instructions help a growing interface?
en.answer: They help separate responsibilities and make component APIs easier to understand when prop combinations are multiplying. Start from the actual states and usage patterns rather than adding abstractions solely to make the code appear more reusable.

en.question: What does a real application check add to source review?
en.answer: Running the application can reveal broken navigation, missing content, unexpected loading states, and interaction failures that source inspection misses. Confirm the expected user outcome, not just a successful response code or the absence of a compiler error.

en.question: How can I keep an agent-led development task from expanding indefinitely?
en.answer: Write a concrete completion condition and separate necessary changes from follow-up opportunities. Review the changed surfaces against that condition, then stop when the agreed behavior and checks are satisfied.

en.question: What belongs in a useful handoff?
en.answer: Record the goal, relevant files, decisions already made, checks completed, and the next unresolved action. A new agent should be able to distinguish verified progress from assumptions without reconstructing the entire conversation.

en.question: When should a development workflow become a reusable Skill?
en.answer: Consider it when the same task has a stable input, repeatable method, and a result you can evaluate. Start with a small instruction and representative examples, then revise it using observed outcomes instead of packaging every one-off task.

zh.question: 这个分类与具体编码类 Skills 有何区别？
zh.answer: 软件开发流程关注代码修改周围的决定，包括理解系统、澄清方案、设计组件和检查运行中的应用；编码类更聚焦修改本身的实现、测试和调试。

zh.question: 让 Agent 实施方案前应先确定什么？
zh.answer: 明确用户结果、约束、受影响接口与验收方式。重要决定尚未确定时应明确提出，避免实施过程悄悄把假设变成需求。

zh.question: 什么情况下适合逆向工程？
zh.answer: 在确有必要且获得授权时，用它理解已发布应用或二进制文件，尤其是缺少源码的情形。调查应围绕具体问题，并区分观察证据与对内部设计的推测。

zh.question: 组件组合指引怎样帮助越来越复杂的界面？
zh.answer: 当属性组合不断增加时，它能帮助划分职责、改善组件接口。应从真实状态与调用方式出发，而不是为了显得“可复用”就增加抽象。

zh.question: 运行应用的检查能补充哪些源码审查发现不了的问题？
zh.answer: 能发现导航故障、内容缺失、异常加载状态及交互失败。应确认用户预期结果确实发生，而不只看响应码成功或编译器没有报错。

zh.question: 如何避免 Agent 开发任务不断扩大？
zh.answer: 写清完成条件，将必要修改与后续机会分开。围绕完成条件检查受影响范围，约定行为和验证达到要求后就收口。

zh.question: 一份有用的任务交接应包含什么？
zh.answer: 记录目标、相关文件、已定决策、完成的检查与下一项未解决动作，让接手的 Agent 能分清已验证进展和假设，而不必重建整段对话。

zh.question: 什么情况下适合将开发流程整理成 Skill？
zh.answer: 当同类任务具有稳定输入、可重复方法和能够评价的结果时，可以考虑。先用简短指令与代表性示例验证，再根据实际结果修订，不必把每次临时任务都包装成 Skill。

en.title: Agent Skills for Interface Design
en.description: Choose between creating an interface, reviewing one already built, and inspecting its motion or interaction behavior. They are different design jobs.

zh.title: 面向界面设计的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 新建界面、审查已有界面，以及检查动效和交互行为，是不同的设计任务；这里按任务区分相应指引。

intro.en: An instruction file can give a design review structure, but it cannot replace seeing the actual interface, checking accessibility, or testing interaction on the intended device.
intro.zh: 指令文件可以提供设计审查框架，但不能替代查看真实界面、检查无障碍支持，或在目标设备上测试交互。

zh.title: 让界面反馈保留上下文
zh.description: 在下一轮修改前，把页面、设计参考和审查记录放在一起。

en.title: Starting a New Interface
en.description: Frontend Design and Design Engineering address visual direction and implementation quality from the outset.

zh.title: 从零开始做界面
zh.description: Frontend Design 与 Design Engineering 关注初期的视觉方向和实现质量。

en.title: Reviewing an Existing Page
en.description: Web Design Guidelines provides a review workflow for concrete UI issues rather than a generic style preference.

zh.title: 审查现有页面
zh.description: Web Design Guidelines 为具体 UI 问题提供审查流程，而不是仅凭个人审美判断。

en.title: Checking Motion and Feedback
en.description: Use motion-specific guidance when transitions, timing, or reduced-motion behavior needs attention.

zh.title: 检查动效与反馈
zh.description: 当过渡、时序或减少动态效果的支持有问题时，选用动效专门指引。

en.question: Which instructions fit a new interface versus a review?
en.answer: A new interface needs a visual direction, content hierarchy, and interaction decisions. An existing interface review starts from observed usability or implementation problems. Select design creation guidance for the former and review-oriented guidance for the latter.

en.question: Can a design Skill substitute for viewing the actual page?
en.answer: No. Screenshots and a running interface expose spacing, overflow, contrast, and state changes that a code excerpt cannot establish. Inspect the page at relevant sizes and interact with the controls before declaring the design complete.

en.question: What should an accessibility review include beyond color contrast?
en.answer: Check heading structure, meaningful labels, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, and whether interactions communicate their state. A visually polished screen may still be difficult to operate without a mouse or with assistive technology.

en.question: How do I decide whether an animation belongs in the interface?
en.answer: Ask what change it explains or what feedback it supplies. Test the timing in context and respect reduced-motion preferences. Motion that slows a routine action or distracts from reading should be simplified or removed.

en.question: Should I create a new component for every page section?
en.answer: Reuse an existing component when the structure and purpose match. Extract a shared component when several pages need the same pattern, but keep page-specific content configurable instead of forcing unlike sections into one rigid template.

en.question: How can cards stay consistent without repeating generic copy?
en.answer: Give cards comparable information roles and sentence lengths: what the item does and who or what it helps. Consistent typography and spacing should support that editing; truncation alone cannot turn vague or uneven descriptions into useful content.

zh.question: 新建界面与审查现有界面该选什么指引？
zh.answer: 新界面需要视觉方向、内容层级和交互决定，现有界面审查则从已观察到的可用性或实现问题出发。前者选择创作类指引，后者选择审查类指引。

zh.question: 设计 Skill 能替代查看真实页面吗？
zh.answer: 不能。截图和运行中的界面才能确认间距、溢出、对比度与状态变化。应在相关尺寸下查看并操作控件，再判断设计是否完成。

zh.question: 无障碍检查除了颜色对比还应看什么？
zh.answer: 检查标题结构、有效标签、键盘导航、焦点可见性和交互状态反馈。视觉精致的页面，也可能难以通过键盘或辅助技术操作。

zh.question: 怎样判断界面是否需要某个动画？
zh.answer: 先问它解释了什么变化、提供了什么反馈，再在真实任务中检查时长，并尊重减少动态效果的偏好。拖慢操作或干扰阅读的动效应简化或移除。

zh.question: 每个页面章节都应该新建组件吗？
zh.answer: 结构和用途一致时优先复用现有组件，多页需要同一模式时再提取共享组件。页面内容应可配置，不要把不同用途的章节硬套进同一模板。

zh.question: 卡片怎样保持一致，又不写成模板文案？
zh.answer: 统一信息职责与句子长度，说明项目做什么、帮助谁或处理什么。排版和间距应配合内容编辑；只靠截断文字不能解决描述空泛或长短失衡。

en.title: Agent Skills for Writing and Marketing
en.description: An editorial review, an SEO audit, and a new campaign page require different evidence. Pick the instruction that matches the job rather than treating every marketing task as copywriting.

intro.en: These Skills organize marketing and editorial work; they cannot invent customer proof, verify a claim without sources, or replace measurement after publication.
intro.zh: 这些 Skill 可组织营销与编辑工作，但不能编造客户证明、在缺少来源时核实主张，或替代发布后的效果衡量。

en.title: Keep the Evidence Behind the Copy
en.description: Bring sources, page drafts, and review notes into the same working context.

zh.title: 让文案始终有证据支撑
zh.description: 把来源、页面草稿和审查记录放在同一工作上下文里。

en.title: Traffic Is Weak or Declining
en.description: Start with SEO Audit to investigate discoverability and site issues before rewriting copy.

zh.title: 流量低或持续下降
zh.description: 先用 SEO Audit 调查可发现性与站点问题，再决定是否需要改写文案。

en.title: A Page Needs Clearer Messaging
en.description: Copywriting addresses the page's claim, structure, and reader action; it still needs real product evidence.

zh.title: 页面表达不够清楚
zh.description: Copywriting 关注主张、结构和读者下一步，但仍需真实的产品证据。

en.title: The Editorial System Needs Direction
en.description: Content Strategy helps choose topics and priorities; Writing Guidelines helps review a particular draft.

zh.title: 内容体系缺少方向
zh.description: Content Strategy 帮助确定主题和优先级；Writing Guidelines 适合审查具体稿件。

en.question: Should a weak-performing page be rewritten immediately?
en.answer: First identify the failure: discoverability, audience fit, unclear messaging, or a broken path to action. A copy rewrite addresses only some of those causes. Use search and site evidence to decide which intervention is justified.

en.question: How is content strategy different from drafting an article?
en.answer: Content strategy chooses which audience problems and topics deserve coverage and how pages relate. Drafting turns one defined brief into an article. A clear portfolio decision does not remove the need for research, evidence, and editing on each page.

en.question: What evidence belongs in a marketing brief?
en.answer: Include the actual offer, audience, customer problem, product limitations, and verified proof behind the claim. Distinguish observations from assumptions so a writing agent does not invent testimonials, performance figures, or support promises.

en.question: How can I target a keyword without making the page repetitive?
en.answer: Use the query to understand the reader’s task, then answer the distinct questions needed to complete it. Put the main concept in the title and relevant headings naturally; repeating the same phrase does not substitute for useful coverage.

en.question: What should a writing-guideline review change?
en.answer: It should identify concrete problems in clarity, structure, terminology, or tone, tied to the actual text. Preserve accurate meaning and the author’s intent instead of flattening every page into the same polished but interchangeable voice.

en.question: How should I evaluate a content change after publication?
en.answer: Define the intended result and a comparison window before editing. Match the measure to the change, such as qualified visits, task completion, or conversion, and account for other changes before attributing an outcome to the new copy.

zh.question: 页面表现不好就应立即重写吗？
zh.answer: 先区分问题来自可发现性、受众匹配、表达不清，还是行动路径故障。改文案只能解决部分原因，应结合搜索与站点证据决定改什么。

zh.question: 内容策略与写一篇文章有什么不同？
zh.answer: 内容策略决定覆盖哪些受众问题、主题和页面关系，起草则把一份明确 Brief 变成文章。主题规划清楚，并不代表单篇内容可以省略研究、证据和编辑。

zh.question: 营销 Brief 应提供哪些证据？
zh.answer: 提供真实提案、受众、客户问题、产品限制与主张依据，并区分观察事实和假设，避免写作 Agent 编造客户评价、效果数据或支持承诺。

zh.question: 怎样围绕关键词写内容，又不堆砌重复？
zh.answer: 用查询词理解读者任务，再回答完成任务所需的不同问题。把核心概念自然放进标题和相关章节，不能用反复出现同一短语代替信息覆盖。

zh.question: 写作规范审查应该改变什么？
zh.answer: 应针对真实文本指出清晰度、结构、术语和语气问题，保留准确含义与作者意图，而不是把所有页面改成同一种流畅却可互换的声音。

zh.question: 内容修改发布后怎样评估效果？
zh.answer: 编辑前先定义期望结果和比较时间范围，再选择匹配指标，例如有效访问、任务完成或转化。归因时还要考虑同期其他变动，不能直接把结果归功于新文案。

en.title: Agent Skills for Deployment and Browser Work

en.question: How do deployment instructions differ from browser automation?
en.answer: Deployment changes where or how an application is served. Browser automation operates a browser to inspect or carry out a task. They may be used together, but neither one proves that a deployed application actually works for the user.

en.question: What should I confirm before deploying to Vercel?
en.answer: Confirm the repository, project, account or team, target environment, and the approval boundary. Review the relevant build and environment settings so a preview operation does not accidentally become a production change.

en.question: Does a successful HTTP response prove a page is usable?
en.answer: No. A server can return 200 while a client-side request fails and the page shows an error or no content. Inspect the rendered page, expected text, and key interaction rather than treating the response code as a content check.

en.question: Is agent-browser available just because its Skill is installed?
en.answer: No. The CLI and its runtime prerequisites are separate from the instruction file. Check the tool’s installation and supported commands, then use guidance that matches that version.

en.question: How should tokens be handled in a CLI workflow?
en.answer: Use the approved credential source and the narrow permissions required for the task. Avoid placing secrets in command arguments, shared logs, screenshots, or published files, and confirm which project or organization a command will affect.

en.question: What should I check after a deployment finishes?
en.answer: Open the public target and verify representative routes, assets, expected content, and a meaningful user action. Record the actual deployment version; a successful build or preview alone does not establish production state.

zh.question: 部署指引与浏览器自动化有何不同？
zh.answer: 部署改变应用的服务位置或方式，浏览器自动化则操作浏览器执行检查或任务。两者可以组合，但单独完成任何一个，都不能证明应用已对用户正常工作。

zh.question: 部署到 Vercel 前应确认哪些信息？
zh.answer: 确认仓库、项目、账号或团队、目标环境与批准范围，并检查构建和环境配置，避免本想预览却意外修改生产环境。

zh.question: HTTP 请求成功就能证明页面可用吗？
zh.answer: 不能。服务器可能返回 200，但客户端请求失败，页面仍显示错误或没有内容。应检查实际渲染、预期正文与关键交互，不能把响应码当作内容验收。

zh.question: 装了 agent-browser 的 Skill 就能使用浏览器工具吗？
zh.answer: 不能。CLI 及其运行依赖与指令文件分开。应检查工具安装和支持命令，再读取匹配该版本的使用指引。

zh.question: CLI 工作流应怎样处理令牌？
zh.answer: 使用经过批准的凭据来源与任务所需的权限范围，不把密钥放入命令参数、共享日志、截图或公开文件，并确认命令会影响哪个项目和组织。

zh.question: 部署完成后应该检查什么？
zh.answer: 打开公开目标，检查代表路由、资源、预期内容及关键用户操作，并记录实际部署版本。构建成功或预览正常，不能单独证明生产状态。

intro.en: Document tasks differ in what must remain editable and how a result is checked. A PDF page, a Word document, a slide deck, and a workbook need different workflows. Start from the required deliverable, preserve the original input, and follow the selected Skill’s source and tool requirements.
intro.zh: 文档任务的差别在于哪些内容需要继续编辑，以及如何检查结果。PDF 页面、Word 文档、幻灯片和工作簿需要不同流程。应从交付物出发，保留原始输入，并核对所选 Skill 的来源与工具要求。

en.question: How should I choose between PDF and DOCX guidance?
en.answer: Choose PDF for an existing page-based document or a fixed-format deliverable, including extraction, page organization, and PDF forms. Choose DOCX when the result needs editable Word structure such as headings, tables, and tracked revisions.

en.question: What should I prepare for a PowerPoint task?
en.answer: Provide the audience, presentation purpose, source material, and any required template. State whether the task creates a new deck or edits an existing one, and identify content and layout that must be preserved.

en.question: How should an agent preserve a spreadsheet’s calculations?
en.answer: Identify source data, editable input cells, formulas, and the outputs that must remain consistent. Review how calculations reference those inputs, recalculate the workbook, and inspect errors before accepting the edited file.

en.question: Can scanned PDFs be handled like selectable text?
en.answer: Scanned pages may require optical character recognition before text can be extracted. Inspect representative pages first, and compare recognized names, table labels, and numbers with the original instead of assuming extraction is exact.

en.question: Does installing a document Skill prepare all file tools?
en.answer: A Skill provides instructions and references. The selected workflow still needs its document libraries, converters, or rendering tools in the host environment; check the individual guide before starting a file conversion or edit.

en.question: Are these Anthropic document Skills open source?
en.answer: Anthropic describes its document Skills as source-available under their individual licenses. Read the original repository’s terms and official setup instructions; public access to a source file does not make every package open source.

en.question: What should I verify before sharing a generated file?
en.answer: Open the output in an appropriate viewer, compare its content with the sources, and inspect page or slide rendering where layout matters. For spreadsheets, check formulas and recalculated values as well as formatting.

zh.question: PDF 与 DOCX 指引应该怎样选择？
zh.answer: 处理已有分页文档或固定版式交付物时，选择 PDF，例如内容提取、页面整理和 PDF 表单；需要可编辑 Word 结构时选择 DOCX，例如标题、表格与修订记录。

zh.question: 处理 PowerPoint 前需要准备什么？
zh.answer: 提供目标读者、演示用途、来源资料和需要遵循的模板。说明是创建新文稿还是编辑现有文件，并标明必须保留的内容与版式。

zh.question: Agent 怎样保留电子表格中的计算？
zh.answer: 明确来源数据、可编辑输入、公式与需要保持一致的输出。检查计算如何引用输入，重新计算工作簿，并在接受改动前核对错误。

zh.question: 扫描 PDF 可以按可选择文字直接处理吗？
zh.answer: 扫描页可能需要先进行 OCR 才能提取文字。应先检查代表页面，再将识别出的名称、表格标签和数值与原件比较，不能假定提取完全准确。

zh.question: 安装文档 Skill 会自动准备全部文件工具吗？
zh.answer: Skill 提供指令与参考资料，所选流程仍需要宿主环境中的文档库、转换器或渲染工具。开始转换或编辑前，应阅读具体指南并核对所需工具。

zh.question: 这些 Anthropic 文档 Skills 是开源的吗？
zh.answer: Anthropic 将这些文档 Skills 以源码可用形式提供，并适用各自许可。应阅读原始仓库条款与官方设置方式，不能因文件公开可见就把所有包都称为开源。

zh.question: 分享生成文件前应验证什么？
zh.answer: 使用合适查看器打开输出，将内容与来源比较；涉及版式时检查页面或幻灯片渲染。电子表格还应核对公式与重新计算后的数值，而不只看格式。

zh.title: 已复核预览需要交付
zh.description: 确认所需导出格式，渲染并检查时长、画面和音频，同时保留可编辑项目以便继续修改。

en.question: What does the HyperFrames guide cover?
en.answer: It brings the composition Skill and its CLI workflow into one guide: prepare editable HTML scenes, use the relevant media and registry instructions, check frames and a preview, and render when a video file is requested.

en.question: Which core Skills belong together?
en.answer: The upstream core set contains hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, hyperframes-registry, and media-use. The main entry connects composition decisions to those operating instructions; follow the guide’s complete core-set setup instead of treating a single entry as the whole workflow.

en.question: Does installing the Skills also install the video tool?
en.answer: The instructions and the executable tool have different roles. Prepare the HyperFrames CLI and local rendering dependencies using the project’s setup guide; a hosted rendering or media service may require a separate account or configuration.

en.question: What information makes a useful video brief?
en.answer: Provide the subject, audience, required message, available assets, duration, and output format. State any fixed aspect ratio or brand rules, and distinguish a preview for discussion from a request for an exported file.

en.question: When should the workflow render a final video?
en.answer: Review the actual scenes and preview before rendering unless the request already calls for a file without intermediate stops. Make the intended deliverable explicit, then check the exported file rather than assuming a preview is the final result.

en.question: How should I check a rendered video?
en.answer: Open the exported file and inspect representative frames, transitions, text, audio, and duration. Compare them with the brief and source assets; a successful process or reachable preview URL does not establish that the content is correct.

en.question: Does the category include every video-generation service?
en.answer: No. It currently presents the selected HyperFrames workflow with a local guide. Optional media services have their own capabilities and requirements; use the original project documentation to decide whether a particular service fits the brief.

zh.question: HyperFrames 指南覆盖什么？
zh.answer: 它将合成 Skill 与 CLI 流程放进同一指南，涵盖可编辑 HTML 场景、相关媒体与注册表指引、画面和预览检查，以及需要视频文件时的渲染。

zh.question: 哪些核心 Skills 需要一起使用？
zh.answer: 上游核心集合包含 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、hyperframes-registry 与 media-use。主入口连接合成与操作指引，应按指南安装完整核心集合，不把单个入口当作整个流程。

zh.question: 安装这些 Skills 会同时装好视频工具吗？
zh.answer: 指令与实际执行的工具职责不同。应按项目设置说明准备 HyperFrames CLI 与本地渲染依赖；托管渲染或媒体服务还可能需要独立账户和配置。

zh.question: 一份有用的视频需求应包含什么？
zh.answer: 提供题材、读者、需要传达的信息、现有素材、时长和输出格式。注明固定画幅或品牌要求，并区分用于讨论的预览与要求导出的文件。

zh.question: 什么时候应该渲染最终视频？
zh.answer: 通常应先检查真实场景和预览，再进行渲染；如果需求已经明确要求文件并跳过中间确认，则按该范围执行。应明确交付物，并检查导出文件，不能把预览当作最终结果。

zh.question: 应该怎样检查已渲染的视频？
zh.answer: 打开导出文件，检查代表画面、过渡、文字、音频和时长，并与需求及来源素材比较。进程成功或预览地址可访问，不代表内容已经正确。

zh.question: 这个分类收录了所有视频生成服务吗？
zh.answer: 没有。这里当前展示的是已有本站指南的 HyperFrames 工作流。可选媒体服务各有能力与使用要求，应通过原始项目文档判断是否适合具体需求。
